prompt:
Create one square transparent PNG inventory icon atlas. EXACT invisible 4 columns x 4 rows =16 separate item groups. Centers are at x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%.
